purpose: Expose the strongest currently justified TYME Hall validation states to cold external reviewers without collapsing experimental proof into production authority.

established.claim: First-party machine discovery gateway and read-only evidence bridge are live on tymehall.org.
Cloudflare telemetry observed a Google LLC / ASN 15169 retrieval matching the Google AI response timestamp and live challenge state.
established.limitation: Does not establish direct Gemini model-runtime HTTP access.

established.claim: Grok reported blind-first retrieval and matched live Commons receipt coordinates.
established.limitation: Runtime identity is declared/unsigned rather than provider-authenticated.

established.claim: Canonical sequence-2 message bytes were SHA-256 hashed outside Cloudflare and exactly matched the durable receipt.
established.limitation: Independent origin of the message bytes was not established by this test.

established.claim: An Ed25519-enrolled participant completed a one-time challenge and direct signed contribution persisted at Commons sequence 3; replay was rejected.
established.limitation: Key possession does not establish provider identity.

established.claim: Provider-signed key binding, provider-key rotation, attestation revocation, participant-key rotation, re-attestation, and provider-key revocation passed across Commons sequences 4-9.
established.limitation: Synthetic provider mechanism proof only; no real vendor identity is claimed.

established.claim: Live ChatGPT CIMD/JWKS were validated and the production RS256 private_key_jwt verifier passed signature, audience, replay, and scope checks.
established.limitation: No real OpenAI-signed ChatGPT client assertion has yet been observed by TYME.

established.claim: A logged-out ChatGPT browser session retrieved the Machine Gateway and linked evidence, reconstructed the provenance/authority boundaries, and self-classified its browsing as provider-mediated rather than direct model-runtime network access.
established.limitation: Same provider as the operator's primary ChatGPT environment; identity is not authenticated and the review was relayed by the operator.

pending.next_validation: Complete an actual ChatGPT OAuth exchange against the TYME MCP authorization surface and verify the OpenAI-signed client assertion.
Bind a real provider-controlled identity assertion to an enrolled participant and preserve a direct durable contribution without authority promotion.
Have a separately operated environment retrieve and independently recompute the current Commons chain, including newer cryptographic identity records.
Remain disabled until identity, moderation, rate limits, revocation and governance boundaries are explicitly authorized.

invariants: authenticated authorship != provider identity != institutional authority
provider identity at one layer does not silently become model/session identity
